image_reference.style_board_prompt: Create one horizontal 3:1 cohesive six-beat visual development frieze for Lancelot and Guinevere: Love Against a Kingdom as a monumental late-19th-century Pre-Raphaelite oil painting. Avoid excessive gilding, jewel-encrusted costumes, glossy fantasy aesthetics, plastic faces and decorative clutter. No text or watermark.
